sourcePolicy.currentSource: Use the Drive preview embedded by the authoritative KICD index.
sourcePolicy.statusPolicy: A Drive preview embedded by the verified live authoritative index is recorded as live. Search-indexed KICD wp-content URLs that returned HTTP 404 are recorded as stale mirrors, not current sources.
sourcePolicy.mirrorHandling: A legacy or stale KICD mirror is retained only as evidence and is not treated as the current source.
sourcePolicy.unknownMetadata: Unverified file titles, publication dates, revision dates, and mirror URLs are null.

specialNeedsEducationScope.reason: This catalog follows the KICD regular-learner Grade Four Designs page. KICD publishes separate Grade 4 designs for learners with hearing impairment, physical impairment and visual impairment.

notes: Creative Arts is the current KICD Grade 4 design label; older Grade 4 inventories separately listed Music, Art and Craft, and Physical and Health Education.
The live curriculum-design index labels Agriculture as 'Agriculture'; some separate 2024 KICD procurement material uses 'Agriculture & Nutrition'.
